description: This Java source file defines the MainSettingsActivity class for the AnySoftKeyboard app, managing the main settings UI, navigation, and permission handling.

classes.name: MainSettingsActivity
classes.description: An activity managing the main settings interface, including navigation and permission requests.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and configures navigation.

methods.name: onPostCreate
methods.description: Applies custom edge effect color and handles permission requests after creation.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents, particularly for permission-related actions.

methods.name: handlePermissionRequest
methods.description: Processes intents to request or revoke permissions, specifically contacts permission.

methods.name: startContactsPermissionRequest
methods.description: Initiates the contacts permission request process.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of permission requests and delegates to helper.
